metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Complete two 3.0 source-contract cleanups: restrict span annotations to supported method targets and require explicit messaging header-name enumeration.

- **Annotations (stable API):** Remove constructor targets from `@WithSpan` and `@AddingSpanAttributes`. Migrate by removing constructor annotations; method instrumentation is unchanged.
- **Messaging (alpha API):** Make `MessagingAttributesGetter.getMessageHeaderNames` abstract. Add missing Camel and Lambda SQS implementations, preserving exact-name lookup and wildcard/exclude-only selectors.

Custom getters must enumerate supported headers, using a snapshot when the carrier is mutable:

```java
@Override
public Iterable<String> getMessageHeaderNames(Request request) {
  return new ArrayList<>(request.headers().keySet());
}
```

Return an empty iterable only for carriers without supported headers. Both source breaks are recorded in the changelog.
metadata.title: Make span annotations method-only and require messaging header-name getters
